provenance_notes: Operator attribution, documentation origin, and live verification are independent properties. A community-maintained document can describe a publisher-operated endpoint.
An operator label does not establish legal corporate ownership, an employment relationship, anonymous access, supported third-party use, or current endpoint functionality.

Endpoint operator attribution follows its service. Emulator entries stay independent; upstream_candidate records the publisher/vendor interface they may reproduce without upgrading its verification status.
